intro: Morocco has two coasts, high mountains and the edge of the Sahara Desert.

chapters.title: Mountains and desert
text: The Atlas Mountains run across the country; Toubkal, 4,167 m, is the highest peak in North Africa. The Rif mountains rise in the north. South of the Atlas, valleys and oases lead to the Sahara's dunes at Erg Chebbi.
Only 14 km of sea separate Morocco from Spain at the Strait of Gibraltar.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The coasts are mild, the mountains snowy in winter, and the south hot and dry.
